name: Facet Spreadface
description: Holds both fans low and folded like a perched hawk and waits for the opponent to commit first.

name: Punishing Rustle
description: Jabs one folded fan straight out from the perch to strike the hollow of the throat.

name: Vanishing Waft
description: Stalks forward in slow level steps with the fans low until the range is closed.

name: Murkfanrib
description: Beats a blade aside with one fan like a wing and answers with the other fan's edge at the neck.

name: Fanoutnerve
description: Pins the opponent's sleeve with the rib tips and steps off so the arm is dragged out of line.

name: Rimribmettle
description: Spreads one fan overhead to cast a shadow across the eyes and strikes underneath it with the other.

name: Blazerustle
description: Gathers qi in both fans then dives into a cut that looses a crescent of force down the line of the stoop.

name: Granite Rimrib
description: Spreads both fans fully and holds them as wings of qi-hardened leaf against a storm of arrows.

name: Glint Pivotpin
description: Springs from the perch on spread fans in a blur across the gap and lands behind the target before it can turn.

name: Aegis Fantip
description: Brings both fans to meet before the face so every blow strikes one or the other.

name: Flutter Reckoning
description: Reaches the left fan far out in a straight jab to the shoulder joint while the right holds the guard.

name: Fantiphavoc
description: Closes the right fan's edge across the same arm from the other side as the left withdraws.

name: Mightfantip
description: Steps back on a straight line with both fans crossed to cover the retreat.

name: Chimefanrib
description: Crosses the ribs of both fans over a thrust and levers it wide of the body.

name: Fanrib Fortitude
description: Opens one fan around a wrist and snaps the other shut on the elbow so the arm is held bent.

name: Chime Rivetpin
description: Beats both fans against the weapon hand in time so the grip fails and the weapon falls.

name: Chimerimrib
description: Slides sideways mirroring the opponent's step and counters with a fan cut to the exposed ribs.

name: Piercing Silkface
description: Stacks both fan tips on one thrust line so their joined point drives through a guard.

name: Fastening Snapshut
description: Brackets the opponent between two spread fans and presses inward to hold them in place.

name: Overpowering Lot Guardrib
description: Brings both fans together on the opponent's chest in a precise tap that locks their qi circulation.

name: Unrelenting Foldedge
description: Bows slightly with both fans trailing at the sides and covers the body with their sweep.

name: Blaze Pivotpin
description: Cuts the edge down the length of the opponent's forearm with the flow of a stream.

name: Fanspine Whirlpool
description: Retreats in a steady formal pace while the fans keep the distance by a hand's width.

name: Iron Guardrib
description: Pokes the rib tip into the muscle at the side of the thigh as the opponent steps past.

name: Hoarfrost Flutter
description: Hooks the opponent's ankle low with an open fan and pulls it back like an undertow.

name: Equipoise Silkface
description: Folds a fan over a thrust and drives the bundled ribs into the opponent's wrist.

name: Rumble Foldedge
description: Beats the leaf against the guard in a flowing rhythm that keeps the opponent from setting their feet.

name: Downpour Rimrib
description: Gathers qi like a river nearing the sea and sweeps both fans out to cut a broad arc.

name: Aegis Spreadface
description: Spins both fans in opposite directions like a whirlpool so every blow is swept off its path.

name: Glamour Fanspine
description: Meets a charging attack on the spinning leaf and curls its force back along the bend toward the one who threw it.

name: Adamantine Rivetpin
description: Folds the azure leaf half closed across the chest and receives the strike on its ribs.

name: Murkrustle
description: Tilts the lacquered leaf to throw a bright patch of light across the opponent's eyes.

name: Berserk Wavering
description: Opens the fan outward in a rising cut that scrapes the opponent's raised guard aside.

name: Murk Guardrib
description: Checks a cut on the closed spine and shrugs the blade off with a roll of the wrist.

name: Fantipflash
description: Spreads the fan and takes one long pace so the leaf covers the advance.

name: Overpowering Fanout
description: Sweeps the open ribs round the weapon arm and hooks it tight to the opponent's own body.

name: Fantipdurance
description: Parries with the leaf then cracks the spine across the elbow and returns the edge to the throat.

name: Phantom Snapshut
description: Rushes in behind a rapidly flicking fan so the blur of blue hides the true line of attack.

name: Ironrimrib
description: Knocks the bundled ribs hard against armor plates to shake the wearer's footing and breath.

name: Waftwrath
description: Gathers qi in the leaf then sweeps three arcs in quick turn so three crescents fan across the field.

name: Corroding Fanout
description: Thrusts the sharpened rib down a single exact line so qi at its tip splits a guard.

name: Charter Silkface
description: Raises the open fan overhead and spreads its qi into a dome that shelters the user from falling blows.

name: Nova Fantip
description: Vanishes behind a sweep of the azure leaf and appears at the opponent's flank when it drops.

name: Charter Foldedge
description: Stands wide with the fans held out like the curve of a basin and the weight settled low.

name: Blaze Fantip
description: Rakes both outer ribs down the opponent's chest together in parallel lines.

name: Siltwaft
description: Slides the feet along the ground as if wading silt so the stance never rises.

name: Gustfanrib
description: Knocks a blow aside with a double rap of both fans' spines and steps off its line.

name: Suffocating Fanrib
description: Flicks a fan upward through loose sand so a veil of grit hangs before the opponent's eyes.

name: Rustleruin
description: Cuts in a spiral that begins at the opponent's guard and ends behind their shoulder.

name: Hoarfrost Fanout
description: Cradles a striking arm between two open leaves and closes them until it cannot swing.

name: Fanspine Nerve
description: Turns a cut over the lip of the fan and sends it spilling aside before cutting back.

name: Mangling Waft
description: Beats the rims of both fans in alternation upon a guard until the arm shakes and drops.

name: Siltrimrib
description: Gathers qi in the curve of both fans and sweeps them wide so a cutting arc fills the basin ahead.

name: Grievous Rivetpin
description: Beats the fans in a slow settling rhythm so mounting pressure presses the opponent lower and lower.

name: Shaderimrib
description: Spins both fans to draw surrounding qi toward the user's hands so foes nearby feel their power sink.

name: Inexorable Spreadface
description: Extends both arms and holds the fans wide to meet a blow at the farthest reach.

name: Fanribruin
description: Strikes with the weighted pivot end as hard as a river stone to the opponent's hand.

name: Rimrib Blink
description: Advances with the fans swaying in slow arcs like weed in a current and gains a hand's width each step.

name: Equipoise Pivotpin
description: Takes a cut along a long curving parry and slips out along the same bend.

name: Overbearing Wavering
description: Hooks a sleeve with one fan and brings the other round as a second stream that pulls the opponent in.

name: Sanguine Wavering
description: Sends small rapid beats against the guard like ripples until the weapon wavers.

name: Merciless Flutter
description: Hurls an open fan in a long even curve over the heads of the front rank to cut at range.

name: Unbudging Fanrib
description: Spreads both fans out in a fan-shaped delta and walks forward as arrows break against the leaves.

name: Reverberating Fanspine
description: Flows through guard then parry then step then cut then throw as one unbroken chain from first contact to last.

name: Unbudging Guardrib
description: Holds the fan flat and still before the chest like a calm pool and takes the first blow on it.

name: Rumble Waft
description: Jabs the shut tip out of a motionless guard so the thrust breaks the stillness without warning.

name: Fanribglare
description: Glides along the line of an imagined shore with the fan trailing low behind the hip.

name: Murkrimrib
description: Sends a small ripple of the wrist through the leaf so a cut slides off its surface.

name: Enthralling Snapshut
description: Tilts the silvered leaf to throw a bright reflected patch across the opponent's eyes.

name: Granite Fanrib
description: Cuts the wrist then slides to the mirrored side of the opponent so the next cut comes from the opposite hand.

name: Enthralling Rustle
description: Catches a blade between the ribs just as its reflection crosses the leaf and twists it out of line.

name: Rimribhavoc
description: Beats the guard in two alternating rhythms like ripples meeting until the opponent loses the count.

name: Mayhemfanrib
description: Gathers qi across the face of the leaf like a lake gathering light then sweeps it out as a cutting crescent.

name: Aegis Silkface
description: Holds the open fan level overhead and spreads a smooth surface of qi that turns falling blows aside.

name: Verity Foldedge
description: Meets an incoming technique with the leaf and breaks its pattern like a mirror struck on its face.

name: Adamantine Rimrib
description: Plants both feet in open country and holds the fan braced across the body in the wind-sworn way.

name: Tempered Spreadface
description: Jabs the shut fan along the line of the wind so the thrust lands before the opponent sees it.

name: Blinding Fanout
description: Steps once to fix a bearing on the opponent and holds that line through the next moves.

name: Webbing Waft
description: Flutters the tassel and leaf like a pennant to draw the eye away from the true hand.

name: Fanribnerve
description: Parries with a turn of the open leaf into the wind and returns a cut along the same line.

name: Fantip Mettle
description: Hooks an arm with the open ribs as a gust fills the leaf and steps round its drag.

name: Rivetpin Ruin
description: Chains three cuts that each ride a forward step with the wind pushing at the user's back.

name: Mayhem Rustle
description: Draws a breath of qi through the leaf and fans it forward as a broad crescent of rushing wind.

name: Tempered Wavering
description: Thrusts the rib tip along the wind with qi at the point to carry it through a held guard.

name: Headlong Nova Rustle
description: Rides a gust of qi across the field in one stride and arrives at the foe's blind side.

name: Pivotpin Obduracy
description: Lifts the fan before the face in the oath stance and receives the first blow on its ribs.

name: Blaze Snapshut
description: Holds the breath and cuts the rib edge across the throat line in one still stroke.

name: Mightfanout
description: Slides one pace to the side without lifting the rear foot so the bearing stays fixed.

name: Flintlike Guardrib
description: Backs the fan with the free palm and turns a heavy cut away from the centre.

name: Murk Rivetpin
description: Flicks the fan edge through loose grit to spray it at the opponent's eyes.

name: Fastening Flutter
description: Hooks the lead ankle with the open ribs and pulls it away while the other hand strikes the chest.

name: Rimribnerve
description: Holds the bearing through a parry and slashes back along it without shifting the feet.

name: Blistering Foldedge
description: Beats the edge against the ribs on the opponent's in-breath so the lungs lock for a moment.

name: Fanoutflash
description: Advances behind a steady gust from the fan that blows dust and leaf-litter into the opponent's face.

name: Shade Fantip
description: Fans a heavy steady current against the opponent that grows with each breath and holds them in place.

name: Chimewaft
description: Throws the opened fan high so it drops on the target from above and cuts through guards held forward.

name: Unbowed Facet Rimrib
description: Holds the oath stance against a heavy attack and sends its force back along the line it came.

name: Fanribspine
description: Holds the fan firm in the thin cold air with the weight low and the leaf angled to the wind.

name: Rimribwrath
description: Draws the cold metal rib across the opponent's sleeve and wrist in one short pull.

name: Blinding Waft
description: Walks a straight bearing across rough ground with the fan carried at the ready.

name: Inexorable Silkface
description: Parries with the open leaf into a cross-gust and slips off the line of the next blow.

name: Spreadface Durance
description: Hooks a leg at the plateau rim with the ribs and pulls toward the drop beside it.

name: Tempered Snapshut
description: Beats the ribs on one fixed bearing so the opponent's weapon is knocked off its own line.

name: Fanribscourge
description: Sweeps the fan through a deep breath of qi so a biting plateau gale rushes across the front.

name: Booming Rustle
description: Drives the shut fan down a fixed bearing with qi at its tip to break a hard guard.

name: Immobilizing Fanout Durance
description: Holds the fan out on the bearing and presses a heavy pall of qi that dulls the power of foes in front.

name: Rimribdurance
description: Stands under open sky with no cover and raises the fan to turn the first blow aside.

name: Granite Wavering
description: Slashes the outer rib low across the opponent's thighs from a crouch on bare ground.

name: Silt Fanrib
description: Slides across open ground without a pause in the line of the fan.

name: Indomitable Fanrib
description: Parries along the line of the wind so the leaf's push adds to the turning of the blade.

name: Maiming Flutter
description: Flicks the leaf up through a gust and stirs a stinging cloud of dust at the opponent's face.

name: Overpowering Guardrib
description: Hooks the weapon arm with the open ribs and drags it out wide across empty ground.

name: Impervious Fanspine
description: Beats a cut down with the spine and beats back at the wrist before the arm can recover.

name: Tempered Rimrib
description: Runs a long diagonal across the field with the fan trailing slashes along the opponent's flank.

name: Slagwaft
description: Gathers qi in the open leaf and sends it forward in a surge that has nothing to break against.

name: Unassailable Fantip
description: Spins the fan overhead in a steady circle that turns thrown stones and arrows on open ground.

name: Harnessing Snapshut
description: Taps the closed ribs on the opponent's chest at the end of a long run so breath and qi both stall.

name: Evergreen Pivotpin
description: Sets a wide stance with the fan angled to meet a gale head-on and spill it past the shoulders.

name: Granite Fanout
description: Cuts with the rib in time with a surge of wind so the stroke lands with extra push.

name: Vanishing Fanspine
description: Steps light with the wind at the heels and covers the gap in a single bound.

name: Foldedge Mettle
description: Flicks the back of the leaf against an arm to flip a blow across the body.

name: Decimating Wavering
description: Whips the tassel round on a gust to sting the opponent's cheek or knuckles.

name: Silkface Devastation
description: Slips along the gale line past the guard and cuts as the body goes by.

name: Strangling Pivotpin
description: Closes the fan on a thrusting wrist and holds it clamped in the ribs against the wind.

name: Might Spreadface
description: Beats the ribs on the guard in a roaring unbroken rhythm until the wrists fail.

name: Torrential Waft
description: Retreats with the wind at the back and slashes the pursuer's face as they close.

name: Shattering Snapshut
description: Gathers qi and sweeps the open fan flat to send a gale cutting across the front.

name: Rampaging Spreadface
description: Throws the open fan into a strong wind so it rides the stream and cuts a far target.

name: Rimribspine
description: Rotates the fan in a steady wheel that bends a blast of wind and blows around the body.

name: Hour Fanrib
description: Runs the fan through feint then parry then hook then sweeping cut as one gale-driven chain across open ground.

name: Charter Fanspine
description: Holds the fan extended in a long guard so incoming blows meet the leaf well before the body.

name: Fanout Scourge
description: Slashes with a full reach of the arm so only the rib tip touches the opponent's forearm.

name: Lightning Rivetpin
description: Glides along the wind line in smooth steps that keep the fan arm level.

name: Rimrib Hardihood
description: Spins the fan like a pinwheel before the face so the opponent cannot read which hand will strike.

name: Impenetrable Rivetpin
description: Parries with a long gust of the leaf and returns the edge across the opponent's reach.

name: Suffocating Waft
description: Hooks a weapon at the guard and pulls with the wind behind the step to tear it free.

name: Granite Foldedge
description: Chains trailing cuts down the wind line so each stroke follows the last without pause.

name: Berserk Silkface
description: Gathers a long breath of qi and sweeps it out as a crescent that runs far across the plateau.

name: Blaze Flutter
description: Throws the shut fan down the wind so its weighted end strikes a target far beyond sword reach.

name: Nova Guardrib
description: Drives a thin concentrated thread of wind through the fan's tip so it passes between armor plates.

name: Thorn Pivotpin
description: Faces the far horizon and holds the fan before the body to receive the first blow.

name: Granite Flutter
description: Jabs the folded tip along the sworn line to the full reach of the arm.

name: Rimribglare
description: Glides across dry grass in near silence with the fan held high to catch the breeze.

name: Glamour Wavering
description: Flicks the leaf toward the sun so a bar of light flashes across the opponent's brow.

name: Fanribdurance
description: Parries on the open leaf along the horizon line and returns the edge to the wrist.

name: Strangling Spreadface
description: Hooks a weapon arm at full reach and hauls it across the body as the user steps in.

name: Foldedge Devastation
description: Beats upward blow after blow on the guard with each stroke lifting the opponent's arms higher.

name: Fanribhavoc
description: Gathers qi toward the horizon then sweeps the fan flat so a long cutting gale rushes outward.

name: Hourrustle
description: Holds the open fan forward and fans a steady heavy wind that presses the opponent back.

name: Snapshut Vortex
description: Sweeps the fan toward the far line and arrives across the whole gap in one stride.
